summary: Only Bucs at Cowboys falls in the window: Baker Mayfield (thumb) is out, so undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts again for 0-4 Tampa (DAL -7.5, total 47.5), and Dallas scratched CB Joey Porter Jr. (illness) alongside CB Cobie Durant.

best.why: Daniels throws short and leaned on Godwin for six catches on seven targets in his first start, and Bowles has said the offense must get Godwin more involved. Dallas ranks last in EPA allowed per dropback and lost corners Porter and Durant, while a likely trailing script indoors keeps Tampa throwing.

NFL|00-0033921|rec.note: Daniels leaned on Godwin as a short-area target in his debut (7 targets), Bowles wants him fed more, and Dallas is missing corners Porter and Durant while trailing script favors passing.

NFL|00-0033921|recyd.note: Same volume case as his catches, but Daniels throws very short (low aDOT), so yardage depends on catch count more than big plays against a weak Dallas secondary.

NFL|00-0038129|rec.note: Otton drew six targets and led Tampa in receiving yards in Daniels' first start; Dallas is without linebacker Overshown and safety Thompson, thinning its middle-of-field coverage.

NFL|00-0036919|rec.note: Gainwell was the only Tampa back targeted last week and caught both looks; a likely trailing script and Dallas pressure should create checkdowns, though coaches have trimmed his overall snaps.

NFL|00-0039361|car.note: Irving has 15-17 carries in three straight games and took 16 of 22 back carries last week as Tampa leaned run-heavy with a rookie QB; glute is managed, and a big deficit is the main risk.

NFL|00-0039361|ryd.note: Clear lead-back share and Dallas' below-average run defense by success rate back the over; several market models project him in the high 50s to 60s.

NFL|00-0035358|kpts.note: McLaughlin practiced fully Wednesday after a hip/groin issue and is cleared; indoors at AT&T Stadium, and a rookie-QB offense facing a soft defense projects to stall into field-goal tries.

NFL|00-0039530|rec.note: Third tight end behind Ferguson; one catch is reachable in multi-TE sets but nothing in the news changes his small role.

NFL|00-0037692|pat.note: Dallas averages over 30 points and scores touchdowns on most red-zone trips, so four extra points is realistic even though the implied team total sits near 27.

NFL|00-0036997|rry.note: Tampa ranks near the top in EPA allowed per handoff, pushing Dallas to win through the air; some of his yardage may shift to short receptions versus the blitz-heavy Bucs.

NFL|00-0036358|recyd.note: Lamb practiced fully (thigh) after a 189-yard game, and Tampa's secondary is missing safety Winfield and rookie corner Morrison; a lead could cap late volume.

NFL|00-0037247|recyd.note: Pickens saw only three targets last week and his total was propped up by one long catch; he is clearly behind Lamb and Ferguson, and a lead limits Dallas' passing.
